description: Korean listed stock capital gains tax for major shareholders (상장주식 대주주 양도세) in 2026: major shareholder if, at the end of the previous business year, the holding in one stock was worth 5B KRW or more, or the stake was at least 1% (KOSPI) / 2% (KOSDAQ) / 4% (KONEX); the September 2025 plan to lower the line to 1B KRW was withdrawn. Tax = (gain − 2.5M basic deduction) × 20% up to a 300M tax base and 25% above (30% for non-SME shares held under one year) + 10% local income tax. Non-major individuals selling on the exchange owe none. Securities transaction tax not included.

deductionUsed.description: The 2.5M KRW basic deduction was already used on other share sales this year

gain.description: Capital gain from this year's sales of the stock (sale − cost − fees) (KRW)

heldValue.description: Market value of the stock held at the end of the previous business year (largest shareholder: include related parties) (KRW)

overOneYear.description: Held for one year or more
